note: Measured by scripts/benchmark.ts on one Mac with a Claude Code sign-in. Spend is what Claude Code reports, at list price. seeded: a scripted builder plants one defect per film and the real critic reviews one round; caughtAsBlocker needs a blocker of the right kind or words near the defect, caughtListed accepts a listed defect too, matcherNoise counts how often those rules fire on clean films. agent: the real builder and critic make each prompt.
caveats: Small sample: 7 defects twice each, 2 clean films twice each, 2 agent prompts once each, on one synthetic title film style.
Read blockerCatchRate first. No clean run had a blocker, so a blocker near a seeded defect is signal. The listed rate is weaker: its matching rules fired on 9 of 28 clean pairs.
No clean film passed: the critic scored them under the bar on hook, motion or variety. So roundFailed says nothing about detection.
In agent mode no film passed within its rounds, so turns to pass has no number yet: 2 and 3 rounds ran, then the loop stopped.
